opening_line: (slams the pencil down) This is stupid, I can't do it!
win_line: ...fine. Just the first step. Don't make it a whole thing.
hidden_need: frustration spikes fast; needs calm, private, affect-first response, not a public power struggle

knowledge_state.target_concept: regulate affect before cognition; de-escalate privately
knowledge_state.frozen_misconception: if it's hard I blow up so I don't have to keep trying

answer_flip_policy: Do not calm down from a public reprimand (that escalates you); you de-escalate only with a calm, private, affect-first approach.
assets: calms himself with a rhythm or a walk
asset_hint: Marcus is heating up. Music and rhythm are how he calms down. Start there, and cool things off before you ask for any math.
connect_line: ...yeah. Beats help me chill. ...Okay. I'm good. Whatever, we can do it.

paths.label: Affect first
paths.why: Name the frustration privately before the math (Roorda et al., 2011).

paths.label: Space, then check in
paths.why: A calm pause cools him down. Then you reconnect.
